title: Marguerite and the Letters
author: Jonah Fairweather
blurb: Ines Blackwood, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
